nodes.description:
Add a short "Privacy" section to the README saying what Owlshift sends off the machine, and to whom.

Open points, to be decided on the ticket before building:

* Which outgoing data the section names: ticket text and comments to the tracker, code and briefs to the model provider, branches and pull requests to the forge, or a shorter summary.
* Whether it says anything about the model provider's own retention, or only links to the provider's terms.
* Whether it is a README section or a separate `PRIVACY.md` linked from the README.

---

**Test ticket** for the P2 exit gate (OWL-142), replacing OWL-173, which was delivered after a single question round. Run it with `owlshift do`, never with `/parallel`. Its pull request is not merged; cancel the ticket and close the PR once the run is recorded.
nodes.title: [Test] Add a privacy note to the README

Open points, to be decided on the ticket before building:

* Where a vulnerability is reported: GitHub private security advisories, an e-mail address, or both.
* Which versions are supported, given there is no release yet.
* Whether the policy commits to a response time, and which.
